sentence: Brokeydokey at the curb beats a lawnchalashout in the driveway.

wombos.definition: A nonchalashout staged on the front lawn — outwardly cutting grass, inwardly unraveling. Suburban-coded.
wombos.example: Dad's been mowing the same strip for an hour — full lawnchalashout.

wombos.definition: An expression of agreement or acknowledgment that someone is broke. Used to accept or confirm a friend's lack of funds without judgment.
wombos.example: He said he couldn't make it to the huzzitorium, and I just said brokeydokey.
